title: Mockup de Kit de Marca Personal Nórdica: Diseño de Identidad Visual para Emprendedor Escandinavo
prompt: A clean, modern personal branding mockup featuring a cohesive visual identity for a female Nordic entrepreneur or content creator. The scene includes a minimalist brand kit displayed on a soft neutral background with Scandinavian design aesthetics. Elements include a framed portrait with elegant Danish typography, a circular logo with a hand-drawn line-art face illustration inspired by Finnish minimalism, and branded merchandise such as a white organic cotton t-shirt, a sustainable canvas tote bag, and a Nordic ceramic mug from Iittala printed with the same logo. A grid-style social media layout showcases portrait photography taken in Copenhagen, behind-the-scenes content from Stockholm creative spaces, inspirational quotes in Swedish and English, and solid color brand tiles in warm beige, cream, and muted terracotta tones reminiscent of Norwegian landscapes. The overall aesthetic is creative, modern, and minimal with soft natural lighting typical of Scandinavian interiors, premium lifestyle photography, balanced composition, Nordic-inspired design principles, high-end branding presentation with an editorial feel, and consistent typography using fonts like Futura or Helvetica. Ideal for a personal brand identity showcase for a European creative professional or lifestyle entrepreneur.
